description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker gemma4-26b-a4b-nvfp4 recipe for NVIDIA's Gemma-4-26B-A4B-NVFP4 (ModelOpt NVFP4, Apache-2.0; checkpoint revision a19cfe00) with Google's gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-assistant MTP drafter (revision 6e5aaaf4), served by vLLM on a single Spark. Runs eugr's published vllm-node image (nightly-20260929, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34, vLLM 0.30.1rc1.dev336+gaf5b4857e and FlashInfer 4a638133) with upstream's launch: InstantTensor loading, FP8 KV cache, prefix caching, gemma4 reasoning and tool-call parsers, MTP speculative decoding with four tokens and a Triton drafter MoE backend, 262,144-token context, 8,192 batched tokens and memory utilisation 0.7 (upstream defaults); the sequence limit is left to vLLM's default as upstream sets none. The target weights mount at /models/target and the drafter at /models/assistant, so the speculative-config model is the mounted drafter path instead of upstream's Hugging Face id. Upstream's recipe is solo-only (tensor parallel 1 here; its tensor_parallel default of 2 and --distributed-executor-backend ray are not used in solo mode). No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.7 as in eugr's recipes/gemma4-26b-a4b-nvfp4.yaml at 4709188d (lines 28-30). The steady per-node peak is 0.7 x 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus 8 GB for CUDA context, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers (a speculative draft is profiled inside the utilization budget); the reserve is 8 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak.
title: Gemma 4 26B-A4B NVFP4 MTP vLLM single Spark (eugr)
